Laravel 12 project. Packages: Fortify v1, Framework v12, Prompts v0, Socialite v5, Flux UI Free v2, Livewire v4, Boost v2, MCP v0, Pail v1, Pint v1, Sail v1, Pest v4, PHPUnit v12. Follow existing conventions; inspect sibling files before editing. Use descriptive names; reuse existing components. Stick to existing directories; don't create base folders without approval. Do not change dependencies without approval. You must only create documentation files if explicitly requested by the user. Be concise. Do not create verification scripts or tinker when tests cover functionality. Every change must be programmatically tested: write/update tests and run affected tests; use the minimum needed (`php artisan test --compact` with specific filename or filter). Do NOT delete tests without approval.

Activate the relevant skill whenever working in its domain:
- `fluxui-development`: Flux/UI components, forms, inputs, or user mentions Flux/UI components.
- `livewire-development`: Livewire components, directives, reactivity, tests, or related user requests.
- `pest-testing`: tests, assertions, coverage, or related requests.
- `tailwindcss-development`: styling, Tailwind, or visual/UI changes.
- `developing-with-fortify`: authentication features.

Use Boost tools: `search-docs` before code changes and other approaches for Laravel/ecosystem; always use it for version-specific Laravel, Pest, Tailwind, and Fortify docs. Use broad, simple topic queries (multiple when useful); don't include package names. Use `list-artisan-commands` to check Artisan parameters. Use `get-absolute-url` when sharing project URLs. Use `tinker` for PHP debugging/Eloquent queries; `database-query` for read-only DB access; `database-schema` before migrations/models; `browser-logs` for recent logs only.

PHP: Always use curly braces for control structures, explicit return types, and parameter type hints. Use constructor property promotion; do not allow empty `__construct()` methods with zero parameters unless private. Prefer PHPDoc over inline comments; never comment in code unless logic is exceptionally complex. Add array shape types when useful. Enum keys typically TitleCase.

Laravel: Use `php artisan make:` for new files; generic PHP classes use `php artisan make:class`. Pass `--no-interaction` and correct `--options` to Artisan commands. Use Eloquent relationships with return types; prefer ORM/models over raw queries, avoid `DB::`, eager-load to prevent N+1; query builder for complex operations. New models need useful factories and seeders; ask whether additional items are needed and check `php artisan make:model` options with `list-artisan-commands`. APIs default to versioned Eloquent Resources unless existing conventions differ. Always use Form Requests (rules and custom messages); inspect sibling requests for rule style. Use built-in auth/authorization. Prefer named routes and `route()`. Queue time-consuming work with `ShouldQueue`. Use env vars only in config files; elsewhere use `config('app.name')`, not `env('APP_NAME')`. Use model factories and check custom states in tests; follow existing Faker style. Tests: `php artisan make:test [options] {name}`; use `--unit` for unit tests; most should be feature tests. Laravel 11+ streamlined structure: middleware in `bootstrap/app.php` via `Application::configure()->withMiddleware()`, not `app/Http/Kernel.php`; providers in `bootstrap/providers.php`; console config in `bootstrap/app.php` or `routes/console.php`; `app/Console/Commands/` auto-registers. Preserve every existing column attribute when modifying a column. Laravel 12 supports eager-load limits (`$query->latest()->limit(10);`). Prefer model `casts()` if consistent with sibling models. On Vite manifest errors, run `npm run build` or ask user to run `npm run dev` or `composer run dev`. If frontend changes aren't visible, ask user to run `npm run build`, `npm run dev`, or `composer run dev`.

Flux: use available `<flux:*>` components; this project uses Free edition (not Pro).
Livewire: use Alpine.js when client-side interaction is needed; state is server-side; validate and authorize actions.
Pest: create tests with `php artisan make:test --pest {name}`; run `php artisan test --compact` or `php artisan test --compact --filter=testName`.
Pint: before finalizing, run `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent`. Do not run `vendor/bin/pint --test --format agent`, simply run `vendor/bin/pint --format agent` to fix formatting issues.
